name: NEWSolutions.org (Partner)
desc:
NEWSolutions is a program for individuals 55 and older, offering remote and in-person job opportunities across Oklahoma. Some positions require prior experience, while others are open to candidates with none.

https://newsolutions.org/jobs/open-positions-in/?state_abbr=REMOTE&program=
skills: Varies per job. Each position has the amount of hours worked per week, pay per hour, and required skills.
notes: NEWSolutions.org is a federally funded program matching those 55 yr or older with other opportunities.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
